Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: high quality portrait 9:16 background for Loadgistic's East African freight operations campaign, with minimal text added separately.
Primary request: show the practical work of keeping a known network of transporters in view, available cargo space and routes for brokers and commercial shippers. Credible, grounded, commercially appealing, not a generic futuristic tech app or a luxury European highway advert.
Scene: an active Ethiopian road-freight yard inspired by the Adama–Modjo corridor in daylight. Concrete warehouse loading bays, dusty ochre yard, distant dry green hills, acacia trees, ordinary useful freight equipment. Do not add flags or invented readable signs.
Subjects: three well maintained but working cab-over freight trucks, common East African shapes: a white rigid cargo truck with a dark teal tarpaulin and visible loading space, a second white-and-blue truck being prepared at a loading bay, and a flatbed trailer with a shorter container and some empty deck. In the lower right foreground an Ethiopian freight dispatcher in everyday shirt and trousers checks a phone while speaking with a driver beside a truck. Adults, competent professionals, natural unposed body language. Phone angled away so no invented app interface or legible personal data is visible.
Composition: premium documentary editorial photograph look, eye-level or slightly elevated wide view; truck and people activity concentrated in the lower 60 percent; calmer dark navy/teal shaded warehouse wall in the upper 35 percent with clean negative space for existing brand mark and short headline. Subjects comfortably inside center 80 percent so portrait can be adapted to 4:5 and square. This is one cohesive photographic scene, not a collage.
Lighting: bright realistic late-morning East African sunlight, balanced warm earth and restrained teal accents, crisp dimensional freight details, natural skin tones, no neon glowing roads, holograms or floating fake UI. Professional, ambitious and useful, not poverty imagery.
Text: no text, no logo, no watermark; brand and actual copy will be applied separately.
Constraints: believable truck proportions, realistic wheels and trailers, safe loading behavior, people not presented as real customers or testimonials. No Western skyscrapers, snow, European motorway, lone heroic mega-truck, drone-shot luxury highway, stereotyped safari landscape, or tech-hype visual effects.
